name: pd.read_parquet(path)
what_it_does: Reads a Parquet (columnar binary) file into a DataFrame — fast, typed, compressed.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Loaded crsp_monthly, compustat_annual, crsp_compustat_link from data/pulls/.

name: df.head(n)
what_it_does: Returns the first n rows (default 5). NOTE: needs the parentheses — df.head without () returns the method object, not data.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Confirmed each parquet loaded and saw column layout.

name: df.shape
what_it_does: Tuple of (n_rows, n_cols). Attribute, no parentheses.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Verified CRSP had 3,409,860 rows x 13 cols.

name: df.columns / df.columns.tolist()
what_it_does: Index of column labels; .tolist() converts to a plain Python list.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Listed CRSP + Compustat schemas before using them.

name: df.dtypes
what_it_does: Per-column data types (Int64, Float64, datetime64, string).
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Checked date parsed as datetime, numerics as Float64.

name: df.describe()
what_it_does: Summary stats: count, mean, std, min, 25/50/75%, max for numeric columns.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Validated B/M distribution — median 0.64, healthy quartiles.

name: len(df)
what_it_does: Row count of a DataFrame.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Measured rows before/after Compustat format filters and the link merge.

name: pd.to_datetime(series)
what_it_does: Parses strings/objects into datetime64 so date math and .dt work.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Converted datadate, linkdt, linkenddt to real dates.

name: series.dt.year / series.dt.month
what_it_does: Datetime accessor — extracts calendar parts as integers.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Built calyear/be_calyear/june_year; filtered month==12 and month==6.

name: pd.Timestamp(str)
what_it_does: Creates a single fixed timestamp.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Filled open-ended link end dates (NaT) with 2099-12-31 so active links survive the date filter.

name: df[col]
what_it_does: Selects one column as a Series.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Accessed prc, shrout, ret, be, bm throughout.

name: df[[c1,c2]]
what_it_does: Selects multiple columns as a DataFrame (note double brackets).
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Printed focused views like [permno,date,me].

name: df[boolean_mask]
what_it_does: Keeps rows where the mask is True (boolean indexing).
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Filtered to Apple, to Dec rows, to positive BE, to NYSE.

name: & | with parentheses
what_it_does: Elementwise AND/OR to combine masks; each condition MUST be parenthesised.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Combined 4 Compustat format filters; combined link date-range bounds.

name: series.isin([...])
what_it_does: Boolean mask: is each value in the given set?
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Enforced shrcd in {10,11}, exchcd in {1,2,3}, linktype in {LU,LC}.

name: series.isna() / pd.notna(x)
what_it_does: isna(): True where missing. pd.notna(): True where present (scalar-safe).
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Counted NA in prc/shrout/ret; guarded each rung of the book_equity ladder.

name: series.all() / series.any()
what_it_does: Collapse a boolean Series to one bool (all True / any True).
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Powered assert statements; .any() checked Apple's permno appeared.

name: series.abs()
what_it_does: Elementwise absolute value.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Fixed CRSP's negative-price convention (neg = bid/ask midpoint, no trade).

name: Series arithmetic (* / + -)
what_it_does: Elementwise math across aligned Series/scalars.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Computed ME=|prc|*shrout/1000, BE=SE+txditc-PS, B/M=be/me_dec.

name: df.copy()
what_it_does: Independent copy so later edits don't mutate the parent / trigger SettingWithCopyWarning.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: After every filter that we kept building on (comp, merged, nyse).

name: df['new'] = ...
what_it_does: Creates or overwrites a column by assignment.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Added absprc, me, be, be_calyear, portfolio_year, bm, buckets.

name: df.rename(columns={old:new})
what_it_does: Renames columns via a mapping.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: me -> me_dec and me -> me_june so the two ME lookups stay distinct.

name: np.where(cond, a, b)
what_it_does: Vectorized if-else with TWO outcomes.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Size bucket: 'S' if me_june<median else 'B'.

name: np.select([conds],[vals],default)
what_it_does: Vectorized multi-way if (3+ outcomes).
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: B/M bucket: 'L' / 'H' / else 'M'.

name: np.nan
what_it_does: IEEE not-a-number; pandas missing marker.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: book_equity returns np.nan when no SE source available.

name: df.sort_values(by=[...])
what_it_does: Sorts rows by one/more columns.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Ordered by permno,date before ME; by gvkey,fyear,datadate before dedup.

name: df.reset_index(drop=True)
what_it_does: Renumbers the row index 0..n-1; drop=True discards the old index.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Clean integer index after sorting/dropping rows.

name: df.drop_duplicates(subset=[...], keep='last')
what_it_does: Removes duplicate rows on key columns; keep='last' retains the final one after sorting.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: One Compustat row per (gvkey,fyear) — kept latest datadate (fiscal-year-change artifacts).

name: df.nlargest(n, col)
what_it_does: Top n rows by a column, sorted descending.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Top-10 ME (validated AAPL/MSFT/GOOGL) and top B/M (distressed micro-caps).

name: df.tail(n)
what_it_does: Last n rows.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Looked at Apple's most recent fiscal years for BE sanity.

name: df.groupby([...])
what_it_does: Splits rows into groups by key(s); returns a lazy GroupBy to aggregate.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Grouped by (gvkey,fyear) for dedup checks; by portfolio_year for breakpoints.

name: gb.size()
what_it_does: Row count per group.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Detected duplicate (gvkey,fyear) rows before dedup.

name: gb[col].nunique()
what_it_does: Count of distinct values per group.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Verified exactly one permno per (gvkey,fyear) after the link merge.

name: gb[col].median()
what_it_does: Median per group.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: NYSE size_median breakpoint per portfolio_year.

name: gb[col].quantile(q)
what_it_does: q-th percentile per group (q in 0..1).
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: NYSE B/M 30th & 70th breakpoints per year.

name: series.max()/.sum()/.mean()
what_it_does: Standard reducers over a Series.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Uniqueness asserts, NA counts, negative-BE count.

name: df.merge(other, on=, how=)
what_it_does: SQL-style join on shared key(s). how: inner/left/right/outer.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Joined Compustat to link table on gvkey (inner).

name: merge(left_on=, right_on=)
what_it_does: Join when the key columns have DIFFERENT names on each side.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: BE calyear <-> Dec ME calyear; portfolio_year <-> june_year.

name: series.fillna(value)
what_it_does: Replaces missing values with a constant.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Open-ended link end dates NaT -> 2099-12-31.

name: def func + df.apply(func, axis=1)
what_it_does: Runs a Python function on each row (axis=1) — flexible but slow; use for genuine row logic.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: book_equity() fallback ladder across seq/ceq/pstk/at/lt.

name: assert cond, 'msg'
what_it_does: Raises AssertionError with msg if cond is False — a tripwire for silent data bugs.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Guarded filter leaks and one-permno-per-key invariants.

name: f-strings
what_it_does: Inline formatted strings: f'{var:,}' adds thousands separators.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Readable row-count and drop-count prints.

name: series.value_counts()
what_it_does: Counts occurrences of each distinct value, descending.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: (Section 8) tally of the 6 portfolio labels S/L..B/H.

name: series.shift(1)
what_it_does: Lags a Series by one period (prior row's value).
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: (Section 9) start-of-month ME weight — avoids look-ahead in value-weighting.

name: series.corr(other)
what_it_does: Pearson correlation between two aligned Series.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: (Section 10) validate own SMB/HML vs Ken French (target > 0.95).

name: string Series + '/' + Series
what_it_does: Elementwise string concatenation of columns.
how_we_used_it_in_RFZ: Combined size+value buckets into 'S/H' etc.
